coverage.A: saved observed X covers full times [100,1300), T=1200; 100 burn-in X values are not retained
coverage.B: saved observed X covers full times [100,3700), T=3600; 100 burn-in X values are not retained
coverage.exogenous_inputs: initial history at full times0..2 and full innovations/schedules are retained; missing burn-in X is not reconstructed here
coverage.pre_rescale_radius: not saved; the number of applied rescales is not inferred from final radii alone
coverage.runtime_check: the frozen simulator checks finiteness before discarding burn-in, but this post hoc audit independently inspects only saved observed X

definitions.RMS: sqrt(mean(X**2)) over every node and the first/last 300 saved observed time points, calculated with overflow-safe scaling
definitions.growth_ratio: late-block RMS divided by early-block RMS; undefined if early RMS is zero; descriptive endpoint ratio, not a fitted growth rate
definitions.max_abs: maximum absolute value over all saved observed time points and nodes
definitions.radius: companion-matrix radius recomputed from each retained final state coefficient tensor; independent mechanisms counted once
definitions.thresholds: none; endpoint block size 300 selected post hoc to match the analysis window, not a prespecified diagnostic cutoff

role: post hoc descriptive audit of retained outputs; no preset stability threshold or general stability claim

support_rule.B_empty_fallback: if the entire proposed B support is empty, copy original A support
support_rule.additions_eligibility: absent in the original state-A base support, not absent after retention deletions
support_rule.base_empty_fallback: force one nonself lag1 edge from random source to its cyclic successor
support_rule.fallback_compatibility: flags only possible activation from final support; false excludes activation, true does not prove it
support_rule.overlap: o is per-base-edge retention probability, not a guarantee that realised shared/A edge fraction equals0.5
support_rule.self_edges: state-A diagonals are cleared; state-B additions include those originally absent self positions at probability0.09
